audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's defect is exact: the content layer never names a single Maokai ability. Everything is 'his W', 'his Q', 'saplings'. Twisted Advance's untargetability during the dash is also never mentioned, and Sap Magic is only ever called 'his passive'.
audit.why: A player who reads 'dodge his W' does not know Twisted Advance is a lock-on dash that cannot be dodged once cast, or that he is untargetable while travelling — so pre-emptively spending Radiant Blast on the dash is wasted. Naming the abilities also makes the cooldowns usable.
audit.corrected: Twisted Advance, Bramble Smash, Sapling Toss, Sap Magic and Nature's Grasp named across whys[0..2], whys[4], mid, wants.you[0] and dosFull[0].d, with the untargetable-mid-dash detail added.
sources: enemyKit W text and flags untargetable/hardCC

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle. The packet reads Maokai, Maokai, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, and early opens 'Levels 1-5 belong to Maokai' — so the page currently awards Kayle levels 2 and 3 in a paragraph that says the opposite.
audit.why: Kayle at levels 1-3 is a melee auto-attacker with one ability against a 525-range lock-on root and 1100-range sapling poke. Level 6 is where Divine Ascent's ranged tier makes the root survivable.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 1 set to Maokai, row 2 to Skill, row 4 to Kayle — four matched full/content pairs. Row 3 already Skill, matching whys[3] ('a wash').

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and mid says level 6 'flips the lane even' while the packet and whys[4] both give the level to Kayle.
audit.why: Twisted Advance at 14s is the timer the whole lane runs on — 'when his W is down' is the page's most repeated instruction and it needs the number. And describing your one power spike as reaching 'even' undersells the row the chart now awards you.
audit.corrected: 14s Twisted Advance and 160s Divine Judgment written in; mid's 'flips the lane even' corrected to 'flips the lane'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nature's Grasp is never mentioned in the content layer at all, despite being a 3000-range advancing wall that roots.
audit.why: The brief flags terrain-cuts-retreat for this pairing: Kayle has no dash, so a wall placed behind her is the kill setup, and that is a Flash decision made before the damage arrives.
audit.corrected: 'Hold Flash for Nature's Grasp cutting your retreat, not for the damage' written into mid.

audit.why: 50.36% over 274 games matches the EVEN label.

edits.before: Maokai's W dashes in to root you and his Q knocks you back, setting up a sapling-and-auto trade your melee Q range can't answer at level 1.
edits.after: Twisted Advance (W) dashes in untargetable to root you and Bramble Smash knocks you back — a trade your melee range cannot answer at level 1.

edits.before: He still only needs his W root plus sapling poke to win trades while you have one ability and melee autos before 6.
edits.after: Twisted Advance (14s) plus Sapling Toss poke wins every trade while you hold one ability and melee autos before 6.

edits.before: Your single point of W barely out-heals his passive-and-sapling chip, and his W can still set up a gank — it's a coinflip on his root timer.
edits.after: Your one W barely out-heals Sap Magic's self-heal and sapling chip, and Twisted Advance still sets up a gank — a coinflip on his root timer.

edits.before: Divine Ascent goes ranged and R blanks his W-root all-in, so you survive the combo and kite his saplings safely for the first time.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged and Divine Judgment (160s) blanks the Twisted Advance all-in — you kite his saplings safely for the first time.

edits.before: Survive levels 1-5 without eating a W root near his tower, where his sapling-and-auto poke can chunk your melee-range Kayle
edits.after: Survive levels 1-5 without eating Twisted Advance near his tower, where Sapling Toss and autos chunk a melee-range Kayle

edits.before: Level 6 flips the lane even. Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged with AoE magic waves and R hands you a few seconds of full invulnerability, so his W root stops being a death sentence — rooted or not, you live through his combo and kite back. Now farm his saplings from range and poke with Q's armor-and-MR shred plus E's missing-health on-hit. Once Nashor's Tooth comes online your ranged DPS out-sustains his passive, and you can shove him off the wave any time his W is down.
edits.after: Level 6 flips the lane. Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged with AoE magic waves and Divine Judgment hands you a few seconds of full invulnerability, so Twisted Advance stops being a death sentence — rooted or not, you live through his combo and kite back. Farm his saplings from range and poke with Radiant Blast's armour-and-MR shred plus E's missing-health on-hit. Hold Flash for Nature's Grasp cutting your retreat, not for the damage — you have no dash. Once Nashor's lands you out-sustain Sap Magic.

edits.before: His lock-on root. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Twisted Advance — 14s, untargetable mid-dash. Dodge it, don't trade it.

notes: The 'never names any of Maokai's abilities' defect was accurate for the content layer; names are now in the whys, mid and wants that a player actually reads mid-game. Left the remaining generic 'his W' references in the boilerplate full-layer breakdown blocks alone — they are template text repeated across every matchup and rewriting them here would drift this page away from the rest of the champion.
